result.description: All-in-one CRM, marketing automation, funnels, calendars, conversations and payments platform for agencies and SMBs (HighLevel / LeadConnector).
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 Authorization Code Grant for Marketplace apps (access token ~24h, refresh token up to 1 year). Private Integration Tokens (static bearer tokens, scoped, per agency or sub-account) for internal use. Legacy v1 API keys are deprecated.
result.access_detail: Marketplace developer account is created automatically, with no manual signup form. You still need a HighLevel agency or sub-account to create apps and Private Integrations. I did not find a plan restriction or pricing on the docs pages, and the account's trial/paid status was not verified. Private apps are capped at 5 unique agency installs. Beyond that, the app must be published Public (listed, installable once approved) or go through Security Review.
result.api_notes: REST API v2 (versions v3, 2023-02-21, 2021-07-28, 2021-04-15) at services.leadconnectorhq.com. It covers contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, payments, forms, workflows, users, custom fields, tags, snapshots and more. Access is at location (sub-account) and agency level. Webhooks cover 50+ events.
result.blocker: Requires a HighLevel agency or sub-account to get credentials. Public distribution needs Marketplace approval or Security Review beyond 5 agency installs. Plan or trial requirements were not verified.

evidence.quote: HighLevel supports the **Authorization Code Grant** flow with v2 APIs.
Private Integrations, to put it simply, are static/fixed OAuth2 Access Tokens.
Private apps are limited to 5 unique Agency installs.
Public Apps: Visible and installable by all users once approved.
By default, all agency admins can create and manage Private Integrations.
Complete REST API documentation for the HighLevel CRM platform.
There’s no key to create, paste, or rotate.
